sloka: अदृष्ट पूर्व व्यसना राज पुत्री यशस्विनी ।तेन दुह्खेन रुदती न एव माम् किम्चित् अब्रवीत् ॥२-५८-३५॥
transliteration: adṛṣṭa pūrva vyasanā rāja putrī yaśasvinī ।tena duhkhena rudatī na eva mām kimcit abravīt ॥2-58-35॥

translations.english: That glorious princess Sita who had never experienced any adversity earlier, weeping with sorrow, could not even speak to me anything.
